title: Exact all-h joint ORIGINAL six-incidence seven-GF5 count from physical two-sided projections
statement: For every genuine W(3,s), s=2^h>=2, and every pair of complete globally injected original maps f,g, let H_P(f) and H_L(g) be the independently built source-half physical-degree-two candidate SETS of six DISTINCT genuine ORIGINAL incidence IDs, with each side original source profile A/B/C. Let J=H_P(f) INTERSECT H_L(g) on the same original IDs, AA the Q in J whose two source profiles are A, and D6 the Q in AA whose two physical coordinate-to-six-original-column dual graphs coincide as a connected six-cycle. Then the count S_s(f,g) of the seven historically accepted positive GF(5) original six-incidence classes satisfies EXACTLY S_s(f,g)=|J|-|AA|+|D6|. The C/C source sector is empty by genuine GQ girth eight.

quantifiers.domain: arbitrary complete separate globally injected ORIGINAL point and line maps, reused across all six-incidence sets

external_dependencies: Previously pinned historical seven positive GF(5) positional classifier: A/B and B/A; A/C and C/A; B/C and C/B; B/B overlapped and disjoint; connected aligned A/A D6 only.
Original source incidence factor multiplicities A=(1^6), B=(2,1^4), C=(2^3), computed independently on the two sides but evaluated on the SAME original Q.
Original 3x3 two-half join from pinned AA4-Q source proof, not a product of independent one-half marginal populations.
limitations: A positive one-side projection marginal population does not force a positive simultaneous join intersection.
The identity does not yield an all-f,g lower bound S_s(f,g)>=c*s^6 or independently solve root Branch A, B or C.
The aligned original-column A/A connected D6 subset is essential; retaining all A/A would overcount.
Source H_P/H_L must be derived from complete globally coherent f/g, never separately resampled per Q.
falsification_boundary: Use six distinct actual original source incidence IDs and both physical projections on exactly those IDs. Any comparison using physical P3 paths, artificial Q, or independent per-Q relabeling does not test this claim.
